rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. - `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. - `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

1: """知识库编排层：入库、列表、详情、删除、重试、检索与重建。
2: 
3: 分层约定（控制器 R3）：
4: 
5: - **请求级错误**（超出大小上限、扩展名不支持）必须抛给调用方
6:   （:class:`PayloadTooLargeError` / :class:`ValidationFailedError`），此时不建行、不落盘；
7: - **内容级错误**（解析、切分、向量化、原文读取失败）在 :func:`ingest_bytes` 等入口内捕获，
8:   落成 ``status="failed"`` + 中文 ``error``（截断 500 字符）后正常返回文档，供前端展示与重试。
9: 
10: 首次入库、``retry_document`` 与 ``rebuild`` 共用 :func:`_index_document`，保证三条路径
11: 的解析/切分/向量化行为完全一致；向量输入统一为 ``f"{heading}\\n{content}"``。
12: """
13: 
14: from __future__ import annotations
15: 
16: import hashlib
17: import logging
18: import uuid
19: from pathlib import Path
20: from typing import Any, Literal
21: 
22: from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
23: from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
24: 
25: from app.core.config import get_settings
26: from app.core.cursor import encode_cursor
27: from app.core.errors import (
28:     ForbiddenError,
29:     NotFoundError,
30:     PayloadTooLargeError,
31:     ValidationFailedError,
32: )
33: from app.core.storage import ObjectNotFoundError, get_storage
34: from app.db.models.knowledge import KnowledgeDocument
35: from app.db.models.user import User
36: from app.db.vector import SearchHit, search_chunks
37: from app.modules.knowledge import repository
38: from app.modules.knowledge.embedding import (
39:     EmbeddingUnavailableError,
40:     FakeEmbeddingProvider,
41:     get_embedding_provider,
42: )
43: from app.modules.knowledge.parsing import parse_document
44: from app.modules.knowledge.repository import visible_filter
45: from app.modules.knowledge.splitting import Chunk, split_text
46: 
47: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
48: 
49: _STORAGE_PREFIX = "knowledge/"
50: _MAX_ERROR_LENGTH = 500
51: # 与 parsing._SUPPORTED_SUFFIXES 保持一致：service 在落库/落盘之前先做请求级校验，
52: # 避免先建行写对象、再因为扩展名被拒绝而留下孤儿数据。
53: _SUPPORTED_SUFFIXES = (".md", ".markdown", ".txt", ".pdf", ".csv", ".json")
54: _DOCUMENT_STATUSES = frozenset({"pending", "indexing", "ready", "failed"})
55: _REBUILD_SCOPES = frozenset({"all", "system", "own"})
56: _MISSING_OBJECT_ERROR = "原始文件缺失，请重新上传"
57: _GENERIC_FAILURE_ERROR = "文档处理失败，请检查文件内容或稍后重试"
58: 
59: 
60: # --------------------------------------------------------------------- 公共工具
61: def _clip(message: str) -> str:
62:     """错误文案统一截断到 500 字符（spec §5.1 的列宽约定）。"""
63:     return (message or "").strip()[:_MAX_ERROR_LENGTH]
64: 
65: 
66: def _failure_message(exc: Exception) -> str:
67:     """把内容级异常转成用户可见的中文文案。
68: 
69:     ``ValueError``（解析/切分）与两个领域异常（embedding 不可用、对象缺失）的文案
70:     按约定本身就是中文，可直接展示；其余底层异常（``RecursionError``、pypdf 的英文
71:     异常等）绝不透出原文，统一中文兜底并记日志。
72:     """
73:     if isinstance(exc, (ValueError, EmbeddingUnavailableError, ObjectNotFoundError)):
74:         return _clip(str(exc)) or _GENERIC_FAILURE_ERROR
75:     logger.exception("知识库文档处理出现未预期异常")
76:     return _GENERIC_FAILURE_ERROR
77: 
78: 
79: def _storage_key(document_id: uuid.UUID, filename: str) -> str:
80:     """后端无关的存储键：``knowledge/<document_id><ext>``，扩展名小写。"""
81:     return f"{_STORAGE_PREFIX}{document_id}{Path(filename).suffix.lower()}"
82: 
83: 
84: def _embedding_text(chunk: Chunk) -> str:
85:     """向量输入必须包含章节标题；否则只出现在标题里的词对向量零贡献。"""
86:     return f"{chunk.heading}\n{chunk.content}" if chunk.heading else chunk.content
87: 
88: 
89: def _estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
90:     """保守 token 估算，与 ``app/agents/prompts._estimate_tokens`` 同口径。"""
91:     cjk = sum(1 for char in text if "\u4e00" <= char <= "\u9fff")
92:     return cjk + max(0, int((len(text) - cjk) * 0.3))
93: 
94: 
95: def _validate_upload(filename: str, raw: bytes, max_bytes: int) -> None:
96:     """请求级校验：扩展名与大小；失败直接抛 4xx，不产生任何副作用。"""
97:     suffix = Path(filename).suffix.lower()
98:     if suffix not in _SUPPORTED_SUFFIXES:
99:         supported = "、".join(_SUPPORTED_SUFFIXES)
100:         raise ValidationFailedError(
101:             f"不支持的文件类型：{suffix or '（无扩展名）'}；仅支持 {supported}"
102:         )
103:     if len(raw) > max_bytes:
104:         raise PayloadTooLargeError(f"上传文件超过大小上限（{max_bytes} 字节）")
105: 
106: 
107: # ------------------------------------------------------------------ 失败状态落库
108: async def _commit_failed(
109:     db: AsyncSession, document: KnowledgeDocument, message: str
110: ) -> KnowledgeDocument:
111:     """把文档置为 failed 并提交；数据库事务被污染时回滚后重建失败记录。"""
112:     message = _clip(message)
113:     # 先把字段快照下来：回滚会让持久化对象过期，甚至让未提交的新行被移除。
114:     snapshot: dict[str, Any] = {
115:         "id": document.id,
116:         "owner_user_id": document.owner_user_id,
117:         "title": document.title,
118:         "filename": document.filename,
119:         "source_uri": document.source_uri,
120:         "category": document.category,
121:         "checksum": document.checksum,
122:         "size_bytes": document.size_bytes,
123:         "storage_key": document.storage_key,
124:         "metadata_": dict(document.metadata_ or {}),
125:     }
126:     document.status = "failed"
127:     document.error = message
128:     document.chunk_count = 0
129:     try:
130:         await db.commit()
131:     except Exception:
132:         logger.exception("知识库失败状态提交失败，回滚后重试写入失败记录")
133:         await db.rollback()
134:     else:
135:         return document
136: 
137:     existing = await db.get(KnowledgeDocument, snapshot["id"])
138:     if existing is None:
139:         existing = KnowledgeDocument(**snapshot, status="failed", error=message, chunk_count=0)
140:         db.add(existing)
141:     else:
142:         existing.status = "failed"
143:         existing.error = message
144:         existing.chunk_count = 0
145:     await db.commit()
146:     return existing
147: 
148: 
149: # --------------------------------------------------------------- 单文档索引流水线
150: async def _index_document(db: AsyncSession, document: KnowledgeDocument, raw: bytes) -> None:
151:     """解析 → 切分 → 向量化 → 批量替换分块，并把文档置为 ready（不提交）。"""
152:     settings = get_settings()
153:     # 先清掉上一轮分块：重试/重建不允许残留旧向量；失败时文档也不应留下半截数据。
154:     await repository.delete_chunks(db, document.id)
155:     document.chunk_count = 0
156: 
157:     parsed = parse_document(document.filename, raw, max_pdf_pages=settings.knowledge_max_pdf_pages)
158:     document.metadata_ = {**parsed.metadata, "characters": len(parsed.text)}
159:     chunks = split_text(
160:         parsed.text,
161:         size=settings.knowledge_chunk_size,
162:         overlap=settings.knowledge_chunk_overlap,
163:         max_chunks=settings.knowledge_max_chunks_per_document,
164:     )
165:     if not chunks:
166:         raise ValueError("文档切分后没有可入库的片段")
167: 
168:     vectors = await get_embedding_provider().embed([_embedding_text(chunk) for chunk in chunks])
169:     if len(vectors) != len(chunks):
170:         raise ValueError("Embedding 返回的向量数量与分块数量不一致")
171: 
172:     rows = [
173:         {
174:             "document_id": document.id,
175:             "chunk_index": chunk.index,
176:             "content": chunk.content,
177:             "embedding": vector,
178:             "token_count": _estimate_tokens(chunk.content),
179:             "metadata_": {**chunk.metadata, "char_start": chunk.char_start},
180:         }
181:         for chunk, vector in zip(chunks, vectors, strict=True)
182:     ]
183:     await repository.insert_chunks(db, rows)
184:     document.status = "ready"
185:     document.chunk_count = len(chunks)
186:     document.error = None
187: 
188: 
189: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------- 入库
190: async def ingest_bytes(
191:     db: AsyncSession,
192:     *,
193:     owner: User | None,
194:     title: str,
195:     filename: str,
196:     category: str,
197:     raw: bytes,
198: ) -> KnowledgeDocument:
199:     """入库一份文档字节；``owner=None`` 表示系统文档。
200: 
201:     - 同归属同 checksum 已存在时直接返回已有文档（幂等，不重复写文件）；
202:     - 内容级失败返回 ``status="failed"`` 的文档，不向调用方抛异常。
203:     """
204:     settings = get_settings()
205:     _validate_upload(filename, raw, settings.knowledge_max_upload_bytes)
206: 
207:     owner_user_id = owner.id if owner is not None else None
208:     checksum = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
209:     existing = await repository.find_by_checksum(db, owner_user_id=owner_user_id, checksum=checksum)
210:     if existing is not None:
211:         return existing
212: 
213:     document = KnowledgeDocument(
214:         owner_user_id=owner_user_id,
215:         title=title.strip() or Path(filename).stem or filename,
216:         filename=filename,
217:         source_uri=filename,
218:         category=(category or "").strip(),
219:         checksum=checksum,
220:         size_bytes=len(raw),
221:         status="indexing",
222:         storage_key="",
223:     )
224:     db.add(document)
225:     try:
226:         await db.flush()
227:     except IntegrityError:
228:         # 并发上传同内容：部分唯一索引兜底，回滚后返回已存在的那一行。
229:         await db.rollback()
230:         existing = await repository.find_by_checksum(
231:             db, owner_user_id=owner_user_id, checksum=checksum
232:         )
233:         if existing is not None:
234:             return existing
235:         raise
236: 
237:     document.storage_key = _storage_key(document.id, filename)
238:     try:
239:         await get_storage().put(document.storage_key, raw)
240:         await _index_document(db, document, raw)
241:     except Exception as exc:
242:         return await _commit_failed(db, document, _failure_message(exc))
243: 
244:     await db.commit()
245:     return document
246: 
247: 
248: # --------------------------------------------------------------------- 查询
249: async def _load_document(
250:     db: AsyncSession, user: User, document_id: uuid.UUID, *, write: bool
251: ) -> KnowledgeDocument:
252:     """读取文档并做权限判定。
253: 
254:     - 他人私有文档一律 404（不泄露存在性）；
255:     - 系统文档所有人可读，但写操作（删除/重试）仅管理员；
256:     - 管理员可读写任意文档。
257:     """
258:     document = await repository.get_document(db, document_id)
259:     if document is None:
260:         raise NotFoundError("文档不存在")
261:     if user.role == "admin":
262:         return document
263:     if document.owner_user_id is None:
264:         if write:
265:             raise ForbiddenError("系统文档仅管理员可操作")
266:         return document
267:     if document.owner_user_id != user.id:
268:         raise NotFoundError("文档不存在")
269:     return document
270: 
271: 
272: async def get_document(db: AsyncSession, user: User, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> KnowledgeDocument:
273:     """按可见性读取文档详情。"""
274:     return await _load_document(db, user, document_id, write=False)
275:

277: async def list_documents(
278:     db: AsyncSession,
279:     user: User,
280:     *,
281:     q: str | None = None,
282:     category: str | None = None,
283:     status: str | None = None,
284:     owner_scope: Literal["visible", "all"] = "visible",
285:     limit: int = 20,
286:     cursor: str | None = None,
287: ) -> tuple[list[KnowledgeDocument], str | None, bool, dict[str, int]]:
288:     """列表 + 游标分页 + 可见范围全量统计。"""
289:     if owner_scope not in {"visible", "all"}:
290:         raise ValidationFailedError("无效的归属范围")
291:     if owner_scope == "all" and user.role != "admin":
292:         raise ForbiddenError("仅管理员可查看全部文档")
